text:
deploy-bot: starting regional rollout for recommendation-service. image pinned for canary: `rec:2026-06-15-1530`. feature flag `rec_rank_v3` -> EU-only tapering. quiet window 21:00-03:00 UTC. Will post checkpoints.

lina: ack. plan: EU cohorts by country weights: FR=0.5%, DE=0.3%, UK=0.2% (total ~1%). ramp steps: 1% aggregate -> 2% -> 10%. hold times: 8m, 12m, 25m.

leo: add sticky sessions for cohorts (45m) to avoid jitter. pin canary pods to nodepool `eu-canary-1`.

devops: infra ready. nodepool eu-canary-1 has capacity for +50 pods. will watch kube-scheduler OOMs.

product: note for release notes: experimental ranking tweak for EU shoppers. include rollback notice in internal notes.

deploy-bot: rollout commands for ops (region/weights supported):
```
/ff set rec_rank_v3 --region eu --weights FR=0.5,DE=0.3,UK=0.2 --cohort canary
/ff set rec_rank_v3 --percent 2
/ff set rec_rank_v3 --percent 10
/ff set rec_rank_v3 --percent 0   # emergency drain
```

telemetry-bot: pre-roll checks done: dashboards up, alerts loaded: `rec.latency.p95`, `rec.5xx.rate`, `rec.ctr.delta`. Alert thresholds: p95>300ms OR 5xx>0.3% OR ctr drop >2% over 5m => paging.

lina: agreed thresholds. also add check for product-safety: sudden ranking regressions (rerank-score delta > 0.12).

deploy-bot: canary step applied: FR=0.5,DE=0.3,UK=0.2. will report back in 8m.

telemetry-bot: 8m checkpoint: p95=180ms, 5xx=0.05%, ctr delta=-0.3% :thumbsup: proceeding to 2% aggregate in 2m.

leo: bump node autoscaler min for eu-canary-1 by +3 to absorb traffic.

devops: done. autoscaler adjusted.

deploy-bot: 2% checkpoint in 12m.

telemetry-bot: 12m checkpoint @ +20m overall: p95=210ms, 5xx=0.08%, ctr delta=-0.9% -> within thresholds, proceeding to 10% in 5m.

product: leaving note to partners team: experimental change may subtly alter ordering for long-tail queries. optional opt-out via account flag (internal).

lina: reminder: rollback is ` /ff set rec_rank_v3 --percent 0 ` first. try flag drain before image revert.

leo: if we need to revert image, use pinned tag rollback `rec:2026-06-10-0911` and coordinate with release-eng.

devops: if paging fires, we will run these steps: 1) set flag -> 0% 2) cordon + drain canary nodes 3) scale down new pods 4) revert image if metrics don't recover in 10m.

telemetry-bot: final 25m soak @10%: p95=220ms, 5xx=0.11%, ctr delta=-1.1% -> all clear. no paging.

deploy-bot: rollout complete to 10% EU. leaving window open for post-roll notes. posting summary to release ticket.

product: thanks everyone. action items: release-eng to draft a customer-facing blurb, devops to monitor autoscaler logs, telemetry to keep the temporary dashboard for 48h.

release-eng (via leo): added a short note to the changelog: "opt-in EU experiment: slightly adjusted recommendation ranking (rec_rank_v3). Gradual rollout, see internal notes for mitigation)"
